name: Betterment Fund Conservation Grants (Maine)
summary: Maine fund whose conservation sector backs land preservation, restoration of threatened habitats, working forests and lake, river and pond water quality, focused on the Western Mountains. Applicants send a letter of inquiry, then a full application if invited.

geography.label: Maine, mainly the Western Mountains (Oxford, Franklin and Somerset counties)

amount.note: Minimum annual grant $10,000; maximum usually does not exceed $35,000; multi-year grants run up to three years

deadline.text: LOI due November 15th, 2026; full application due December 15th, 2026

status.quote: February 2027 Grant Awards LOI Due: November 15th, 2026 Full Application Due: December 15th, 2026

deadline.quote: February 2027 Grant Awards LOI Due: November 15th, 2026 Full Application Due: December 15th, 2026 * All submissions due by 5 pm ET on the specified date.

applicant_types.quote: An application will be accepted from an organization only if, at the time of application, it is either. Publicly supported and exempt from taxation under Internal Revenue Code section 501(c)(3) and not a private foundation; Exempt as a government agency or body; Tribal government; or

geography.quote: The Betterment Fund makes grants exclusively to benefit the residents of the State of Maine and has a historical and continuing priority focus on the Western Mountains region of Maine which includes Oxford, Franklin, and Somerset Counties.

access.quote: Before proceeding with the online application, please be sure to review the details in the Grant Priorities.

window.quote: February 2027 Grant Awards LOI Due: November 15th, 2026 Full Application Due: December 15th, 2026

amount.quote: For application-based grants, the Betterment fund's minimum annual grant is $10,000. The maximum annual grant usually does not exceed $35,000. The average annual grant, whether for multiple years or a single year, is $15,000-$20,000. Three years is the maximum period of time the Fund will consider for a multi-year grant.
